abstract: Operating procedure for migrating the TiendasMass platform (Express + TypeORM + MySQL backend, React + Vite frontend) to Clean Architecture under SOLID principles. Drives the 7-phase incremental refactor defined in SOLID_CLEAN_ARCH_ROADMAP.md: preparation, repository layer (DIP/SRP), service layer + thin controllers, dependency injection with tsyringe, unified frontend Axios client, container/presentational separation, and cleanup + tests. Enforces backward-compatibility (no route/JSON/UI changes), one-module-per-commit, and a validation gate after every module and phase.
